user.title: Add a MoonLight device
user.description: The device's address. A board serves on port 80. MoonLight running on a computer serves on port 8080.

reconfigure.description: The device's address. The MAC must be the device this entry already is.

error.tls_unsupported: MoonLight serves HTTP on the local network. An https:// address cannot be used.
error.unknown: MoonLight could not be read. The log has the reason.

abort.tls_unsupported: MoonLight serves HTTP on the local network.
abort.wrong_device: That address is a different MoonLight device. Add it as a new device.
